tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Main page background. Default ground for content sections.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Secondary background: alternating sections (How we work, Clients), input fields, footer top.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Soft gray card surface for bento and feature cards on bg-100.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Raised white surface: service carousel cards and the nav pill when scrolled.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings and body on bg-100, bg-200, surface-card, surface-white and every tint (≥14.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: supporting copy, captions, meta on bg-100, bg-200, surface-card and the tint-* grounds (≥4.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Not-yet-revealed words in the gray-to-dark text reveal and the trailing muted half of a bento headline. Decorative only (2.1:1): the sentence must read fully in ink once revealed; never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Primary actions (buttons), featured navy cards, the stats band and footer. on-dark text on it is 17.4:1.

tokens.name: midnight-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of midnight buttons and cards.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Logo navy (from the Creativity mark). Links, the active carousel dot, focus ring and icons on light grounds (11.3:1 on bg-100).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Logo gray (from the Creativity mark). Dashed process arrows, step dots, decorative slabs. Not for text (3.2:1 on bg-100, under 3:1 on bg-200).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Atmospheric accent: dots, active markers, superscript units and focus ring on midnight (10.3:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: sky-100
tokens.usage: Pale sky wash: hero fade-out, hover tint of secondary buttons, tag fills on photos.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card outlines where needed, client logo grid rules, input borders.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Floating WhatsApp button only (white glyph, 4:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on midnight, primary and over photography with the hero scrim.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on midnight (9.7:1).

tokens.name: tint-steel
tokens.usage: Services section background while Steel structures is active.

tokens.name: tint-glass
tokens.usage: Services section background while Glass facades is active.

tokens.name: tint-concrete
tokens.usage: Services section background while Concrete & civil works is active.

tokens.name: tint-roads
tokens.usage: Services section background while Roads & asphalt is active.

tokens.name: tint-landscape
tokens.usage: Services section background while Landscaping is active.

tokens.name: tint-industrial
tokens.usage: Services section background while Industrial works is active.

tokens.name: tint-epoxy
tokens.usage: Services section background while Epoxy flooring is active.

tokens.name: tint-interior
tokens.usage: Services section background while Interior fit-out is active.

styles.name: t-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Mobile: 44px. Max 3 lines.

styles.name: t-statement
styles.usage: Centered brand statements with the gray-to-dark reveal. Mobile: 28px.

styles.name: t-stat
styles.usage: Numbers in the stats band. Mobile: 44px.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Default body copy and card descriptions.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels and tags, set in UPPERCASE.

type.font-sans-ar: "Helvetica Neue", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, "Geeza Pro", sans-serif

spacing.note: 8px base scale. Card gaps 16–24; section spacing 128 desktop / 64 mobile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card gap on mobile, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card gap on desktop, inner card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Heading-to-content gap; desktop side padding minimum.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop side padding; mobile section spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Default desktop section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large one-off spacing (no longer the section default).

radius.note: Softened architectural corners: controls 8px, images 12px, cards 16px. Still no pills.

tokens.name: little-border-radius
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, tags, nav link pill, arrow buttons, inputs and selects. Inner arrow squares inside buttons use 5px (little-border-radius - 3px).

tokens.name: radius-image
tokens.usage: Image containers and media inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, bento tiles, project media, the contact form, the hero frame.

shadow.note: Used sparingly; separate surfaces by colour and spacing first.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Active service card, scrolled nav pill.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover on clickable cards.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side padding at 1024px and up.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding below 640px.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Header height.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Button and input height (48–52).
